description: An ET41 with 25 loaded coal wagons (412W, 60 t each, cast-iron blocks, G; about 1670 t) on a line of its own beside td.scn: from the level down a gradient of 20 per mille at the 60 km/h of its timetable, into a 20 km/h restriction 400 m long 1500 m down the gradient, then to the signal at stop 3000 m down. The train is to pass through the restriction without coming to a stand, and stop at the signal (#263, #187).
